question: Can present G identify the direction or magnitude of original-EOG geometry change under idealised A/B/M mask release, even when the resulting spatial map is not identified?
evidence: Ideal complete current presence/absence: survivors have exactly identical occupied mask G within each system. This is stronger evidence than real presence-only observations.
reference: Original per-landscape median/MAD feature transform on all candidate nodes. No group-specific rescaling. All12 systems/768 parent G spans checked against frozen parent output.

targets.primary: change in EOG90th-percentile strictly positive pairwise distance span
secondary: convex-hull area as monotone extent control
geographic rook-component count as separate structural target

target_semantics: All finite occupied cells, equal cell weights. This is exact full-census geometry, NOT matched-size sampled geometry. A change in number and arrangement of occupied cells is part of the target. No resampling or p values.
identification: For every current-G fibre and each release axis, retain min/max change across ALL survivors; direction identified only if all agree (negative/zero/positive); magnitude identified if range<=1e-10*max(1,abs(values)). No probability weights assigned to worlds.
secondary_evidence: Known exact A, B or M masks individually: partition each G fibre by the extra observed mask, report direction identification gain. These are idealised complete direct measurements, not single field observations.
denominators: Report129 expected G-fibres and all768 model-world memberships separately; primary descriptive counts by fibre and12 landscapes, not independent ecological repetitions. Retain eligible and unidentifiable counts, plus fibres with multiple distinct A/B/M mask triples.
integrity: hull area never decreases under release (within tolerance)
map identification implies geometry magnitude and direction identification
valid extra evidence cannot broaden any target envelope
examples: Choose lexicographically first exact-map-ambiguous yet direction-identified fibre, and lexicographically first opposite-sign fibre, from primary span; do not choose largest effect.
non_goals: literal corridor-restoration, climate or partner manipulation effects
